Name: WaterDrivenInfrastructure
Author: Jared
Description: Adds water-powered sawmills, forges, grinding and stamp mills, ore sluices, fishponds, fish funnels and mill race outlets. Build a water wheel on a river, then run your machines from it. A Mill Race Outlet gives unclean water at any outdoor location. Craft a Mill Race, build the outlet anywhere outside, and draw water freely. It freezes in winter, but a lit fire, or a hot Water-Driven Forge or Workshop, keeps the stations at that location running. By default every station stops in winter without such heat, even beside a river; a setting turns that off. A running outlet also fills a Rain Cistern there with river water for the winter. Feed your fishpond, plant reed and cattail beds where the race brings water, build a Water Basin for Sanctuary, and fit an Overshot Wheel to speed up a sawmill, grinding mill, workshop or ore sluice. A water-driven stamp mill crushes greenstone and bog iron a hopper at a time. A water-driven fulling mill beats finished cloth a batch at a time to raise its quality (the one thing the base game never improves after weaving). A retting pit soaks flax stems, nettle stems and reeds at an outlet-watered base exactly as a river does, no faster and to the same quality. An irrigation channel fed by a running outlet keeps Flax, Wheat, Pea and Turnroot fields out of drought in a dry spell, without making them grow faster. Building and working the stations trains Smithing, Crafting, Woodworking, Herbalism and Fishing. Needs only CSFFModFramework 2.29.0 or later. Every recipe uses the framework's shared Metal Nail, Tin Solder and Metal Sheet, and WDI's own old rivets, solder and cast sheets turn into those by themselves in an existing save. Advanced Copper Tools is optional. Tested with EA 0.69c.
